dedupe_keys.name: oppervlaktewater voor de bereiding van drinkwater ogv 2010 historie

description: Oppervlaktewater voor de bereiding van drinkwater (OGV, 2010) (historie) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Provinciale Staten van Drenthe hebben op 2 juni 1970 de Omgevingsvisie vastgesteld. Hierin staan op kaart 9 (Oppervlaktewater) en kaart 10 (Kaderrichtlijn water) de locaties van het oppervlaktewater dat wordt gebruikt voor de bereiding van drinkwater. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are omgevingsvisie. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
